scope: U1–U5 from individual observed landing checkpoints through last fresh K1, or failure, plus the U2 after-second-seam checkpoint.
method: Per-frame PhysX contact and raw impulse audit for each moving cup. An approach ends on the precontact event before entering K1. TCP normal gap is measured and independently replayed against the simultaneous PhysX cube pose. Other-wrist contact is evaluated only during its own approach window. Isaac Sim was run headless, with one instance at a time and per-box checkpoint restarts.

historical_a_supply_check.scope: Retrospective Isaac Sim A-stage unloaded supply approaches to the observed face plus a nominal 7 mm.
historical_a_supply_check.method: Join sensor-input and PhysX-reference frames on physics_step in the inclusive A_approach to A_seal_contact range for the specified cube. A_seal_contact is recorded before starting the tactile seek. At the last step, subtract 75 mm from the signed projection of the encoder TCP relative to the PhysX center along the actual X face normal. Count frames with the cup touch flag or a positive same-frame raw cup contact impulse.
historical_a_supply_check.implementation: Online path planning via RRTConnect planner to the 35 mm staging pose, then a collision-checked Cartesian segment to the 7 mm target. Historical snapshots predate the explicit A PRECONTACT_REACHED gate.

measured_joint_collision_replay.method: Reconstruct joint and rail states from measured samples and replay Lula spheres and full tool OBBs against the observed fixture restored in PhysX and the per-step actual active-cube pose. In the side approach allow the established contact of the other pusher only. Tests use a 2 mm model margin. The rail moves have separate online checks.
